accountId.title: Account Id
accountId.description: The Account Id associated with this customer. Use this for subsequent actions that require account validation.

customer.title: Customer
customer.description: Customer (Contact) details. Null when found=false or on error.

customerJson.title: Customer JSON
customerJson.description: JSON-serialized version of customer for clients that prefer JSON parsing. This is "null" when customer is null.

firstName.title: First Name
firstName.description: Customer first name (Contact.FirstName). Duplicated as a top-level string output for easy Flow mapping.

found.title: Found
found.description: True when a Contact record was found for the provided verifiedCustomerId.

lastName.title: Last Name
lastName.description: Customer last name (Contact.LastName). Duplicated as a top-level string output for easy Flow mapping.

message.title: Message
message.description: User-readable status message. On errors, explains what was missing or what failed.

success.title: Success
success.description: True when the action executed successfully. False when inputs are missing/invalid or an unexpected error occurred.

verifiedCustomerId.title: Verified Customer Id
verifiedCustomerId.description: The Contact Id for the verified customer. Use this for subsequent actions that require a Contact Id.
